scripts.cf:setup: wrangler d1 create golemdocs-directory && wrangler r2 bucket create golemdocs-files
scripts.cf:setup:dev: wrangler d1 create golemdocs-directory-dev && wrangler r2 bucket create golemdocs-files-dev
scripts.cf:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DIRECTORY --env dev --remote
scripts.cf:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DIRECTORY --env local --local
